lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum har setee raate sa(n)tahu ||
lines.translation: O Saint, You are attuned to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਓੜਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੁ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nibaahi lehu mo kau purakh bidhaate oR pahuchaavahu daate ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please stand my me, Architect of Destiny; please take me to my destination, Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਤੁਮਾ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaraa maram tumaa hee jaaniaa tum pooran purakh bidhaate ||
lines.translation: You alone know Your mystery; You are the Perfect Architect of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raakhahu saran anaath deen kau karahu hamaaree gaate ||1||
lines.translation: I am a helpless orphan - please keep me under Your Protection and save me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taran saagar bohith charan tumaare tum jaanahu apunee bhaate ||
lines.translation: Your Feet are the boat to carry us across the world-ocean; You alone know Your ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa jis raakhahu sa(n)ge te te paar paraate ||2||
lines.translation: Those whom You keep protected, by Your Kindness, cross over to the other side. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eet oot prabh tum samarathaa sabh kichh tumarai haathe ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, God, You are All-powerful; everything is in Your Hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਚਲੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa nidhaan dehu mo kau har jan chalai hamaarai saathe ||3||
lines.translation: Please give me that treasure, which will go along with me, O servant of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: niraguneeaare kau gun keejai har naam meraa man jaape ||
lines.translation: I am without virtue - please bless me with virtue, so that my mind might chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad naanak har bhete man tan seetal dhraape ||4||14||135||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothed and satisfied. ||4||14||135||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaaio dev ||
lines.translation: I am intuitively absorbed in the Divine Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau satigur bhae daiaal dev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Divine True Guru has become Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਕੀਓ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਟਹਲਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaat jevaree keeo daasaro sa(n)tan tahalaaio ||
lines.translation: Cutting away the halter, He has made me His slave, and now I work for the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਥੀਓ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek naam ko theeo poojaaree mo kau acharaj gurahi dikhaaio ||1||
lines.translation: I have become a worshipper of the One Name; the Guru has shown me this amazing wonder. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio pragaas sarab ujeeaaraa gur giaan manahi pragataaio ||
lines.translation: The Divine Light has dawned, and everything is illuminated; the Guru has revealed this spiritual wisdom to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਓ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਨਭੈ ਠਹਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam peeo man tripatiaa anabhai thaharaaio ||2||
lines.translation: Drinking deeply of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, my mind is satisfied, and my fears have been vanquished. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਦੂਖਹ ਠਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan aagiaa sarab sukh paae dookhah thaau gavaaio ||
lines.translation: Accepting the Command of the Lord's Will, I have found total peace; the home of suffering has been destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jau suprasa(n)n bhae prabh thaakur sabh aanad roop dikhaaio ||3||
lines.translation: When God, our Lord and Master was totally pleased, He revealed everything in the form of ecstasy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਤ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa kichh aavat naa kichh jaavat sabh khel keeo har raaio ||
lines.translation: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; this play is all set in motion by the Lord, the Sovereign King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak agam agam hai thaakur bhagat tek har naaio ||4||15||136||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, our Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable. The Lord's devotees take His Name as their Support. ||4||15||136||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₆ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesur man taa kee ot gaheejai re ||
lines.translation: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord; O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the One

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin dhaare brahama(n)d kha(n)d har taa ko naam japeejai re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: who established the solar systems and galaxies. Chant the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan hukam boojh sukh paaeeai re ||
lines.translation: Renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord; understanding the Hukam of His Command, peace is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਓਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh karai soee bhal maanahu sukh dukh ohee dhiaaeeai re ||1||
lines.translation: Whatever God does, accept that with pleasure; in comfort and in suffering, meditate on Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot patit udhaare khin mahi karate baar na laagai re ||
lines.translation: The Creator emancipates millions of sinners in an instant, without a moment's delay.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: deen darad dukh bha(n)jan suaamee jis bhaavai tisahi nivaajai re ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Destroyer of the pain and sorrow of the poor, blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko maat pitaa pratipaalak jee praan sukh saagar re ||
lines.translation: He is Mother and Father, the Cherisher of all; He is the Breath of life of all beings, the Ocean of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: de(n)de tot naahee tis karate poor rahio ratanaagar re ||3||
lines.translation: While giving so generously, the Creator does not diminish at all. The Source of jewels, He is All-pervading. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaachik jaachai naam teraa suaamee ghat ghat a(n)tar soee re ||
lines.translation: The beggar begs for Your Name, O Lord and Master; God is contained deep within the nucleus of each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas taa kee saranaaee jaa te brithaa na koee re ||4||16||137||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; no one returns from Him empty-handed. ||4||16||137||
